Sensofar offers a versatile range of non-contact 3D optical profiler systems for surface measurement, surface characterization, and quality control.

Flexible configurations, advanced software, and automation capabilities help adapt each system to different samples, applications, and measurement environments, from research laboratories to automated production inspection.

At Sensofar, light becomes insight. We develop non-contact 3D optical metrology systems that reveal the surface details defining how materials, components, and processes perform.

By combining high-performance technologies, metrological expertise, and application-driven engineering, we transform surface data into reliable knowledge. This helps research, engineering, and quality teams reduce uncertainty, improve processes, validate performance, and make clearer technical decisions.
Obtain accurate, precise, and meaningful surface data backed by more than 25 years of experience in optical profilometry.
Move from initial evaluation to advanced measurement workflows with a team that understands your application and stays close throughout the process.

What is a 3D optical profiler?
A 3D optical profiler is a non-contact measurement system used to capture surface topography and evaluate features such as roughness, texture, form, height, volume, and critical dimensions.
What can Sensofar optical profilers measure?
Sensofar solutions support applications in semiconductors, advanced packaging, photonics, precision manufacturing, medical devices, consumer electronics, aerospace, tooling, and research.
Does Sensofar provide systems for automated inspection?
Yes. Sensofar provides integrable metrology systems, automation-ready software, and configurable solutions for production inspection, OEM integration, and process control.
